answer: Give each identity a low initial reward allotment and increase it only after unrelated reviewers validate randomly chosen work against signed source records. Merge accounts that share endorsers or reuse evidence and apply one cap to the combined group. Reviewers might cross-check an oasis water sample with its lab sheet, compare karst features with a geotagged survey, or verify the origin of an umber pigment batch. A Sybil operator must maintain distinct, auditable histories and win separate trust; adding keys alone earns nothing.
